title: Rabbi Yehudah ben Gadya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Tzav, [section] 9: he said, Whoever answers Amen in this world merits and answers Amen in the World to Come.
In Eichah Rabbah, chapter 3, in the tav section, Rabbi Yehudah ben Gadya says: “Repay them their recompense,” etc. In Pesikta de-Rav Kahana 25b

and Tanchuma, Ki Teitzei 10, this saying is attributed to Rabbi Yudan ben Gadya. Under this name he appears at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:1: Rabbi Yudan bar Gadya and Rabbi Yaakov bar Bun say to leave them on it until they wither.

notes.text: The quotation runs from the Pesikta citation in one unit into the Tanchuma citation in the next; it is not a missing continuation.
The ת in the Eichah Rabbah chapter 3 locator is the acrostic letter tav, accompanying the verse “Repay them their recompense”; it is not a section numbered 400.
